title: Named, characterized NPCs sometimes have no dialogue option at all: 'a barrow-widow' at The Tithe Barn (Barrowmere) gets a full descriptive line ('Sits by the tithe barn's stove like she's waiting for someone who isn't coming, and knows it') but no 'talk to' entry; 'gate captain' at The Palace Gate (Marrowgate) is likewise described but not talkable.
